nodes.name: TypedDmgBoost.ts
nodes.summary: Calculates per-damage-type damage multipliers and heal multipliers from active buffs and perks (e.g., Glyph Conduit for magic, Rage for physical/magic/water, Photosynthesis for holy/earth in sunlight). Aggregates into a dmgMultByType map.

functions.name: calcTypedDmgBoosts
functions.summary: Computes per-type damage multipliers and a global heal multiplier by evaluating all typed damage boost definitions against active perks, buffs, and context (sunlight, draconic color).

nodes.name: Weaponartcheck.ts
nodes.summary: Validates whether a weapon art's requirements (scaling, stats, weapon type, guild, both-parts) are met by the current build, and produces human-readable lists of unmet requirements.

functions.name: checkWA
functions.summary: Returns true if the weapon art's requirements (guild, weapon type, scaling, stats, both-parts) are fully satisfied by the build.

functions.name: getUnmetReqs
functions.summary: Returns an array of human-readable strings describing which weapon art requirements are not met.

nodes.name: weaponArts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the WeaponArt and WeaponArtRequirement interfaces and the WEAPON_ARTS data array containing all weapon art definitions with their names, descriptions, cooldowns, damage, scaling, hits, and requirements.

nodes.name: damage-types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines all damage type metadata (labels, colors), defense inheritance mappings, type priority ordering, and exported constant arrays for the game's 11 damage types (physical, magic, fire, water, earth, air, hex, holy, true, summon, heal).

nodes.name: damageTypeResolve.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves weapon art damage types from string descriptions into numeric type maps, applies type bonuses, and performs damage type conversions (Fire<->Air via Echo Incineration, Air->Magic via Spirit Winds, Dark Magic hex bonus).

functions.name: resolveDamageTypes
functions.summary: Merges base damage types with bonus damage types by summing corresponding keys.

functions.name: applyFireAirConversion
functions.summary: Converts 50% of Fire damage to Air and 50% of Air damage to Fire (Echo Incineration).

functions.name: resolveWaDamageTypeKeys
functions.summary: Parses a weapon art's damage type string ('Same as weapon', 'Highest damage type', or explicit multi-type) into a numeric type map.

functions.name: getFinalWaDmgTypes
functions.summary: Combines resolveWaDamageTypeKeys with resolveDamageTypes to produce the final weapon art damage type distribution.

functions.name: applyAirToMagicConversion
functions.summary: Converts a fraction of Air to Magic (Spirit Winds), then applies Fire<->Air conversion (Echo Incineration), then adds Dark Magic hex bonus from native magic.

nodes.name: _utils.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal utility module exporting round2 and round4 functions for numeric rounding with epsilon correction, used throughout the engine layer.

functions.name: round2
functions.summary: Rounds a number to 2 decimal places with epsilon correction.

functions.name: round4
functions.summary: Rounds a number to 4 decimal places with epsilon correction.

nodes.name: build.ts
nodes.summary: Core build calculation engine: accumulates stats and perks from all equipment slots (race, guild, armor, ring, rune, weapon), applies enchantments and infusions, finalizes perks with effectiveness scaling, computes CDR, boosts, crit, and assembles active buffs. Exports calcBuild as the main entry point.

functions.name: calcBuild
functions.summary: Main entry point: accumulates equipment stats/perks, finalizes perks, and derives the full BuildResult with boosted stats, CDR, boosts, and crit.

nodes.name: data.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-export module that re-exports all symbols from character, equipment, and weapon data sub-modules, providing a single import point for game data accessors.

nodes.name: enchant.ts
nodes.summary: Enchantment application engine: applies stat-selecting enchantments (Restored, Flawless), direct stat modifiers, perk modifiers, perk effectiveness scaling, infusion (50% stat halving), and exclusive enchant slot enforcement.

functions.name: applyEnchantmentsToSlot
functions.summary: Applies a list of enchantments to an equipment slot's base stats and perks, handling stat selectors, direct modifiers, perk modifiers, and upgrade levels.

functions.name: applyPerkEffectiveness
functions.summary: Scales all perks by (1 + PE * 0.1) * (1 + Cursed * 0.1), exempting enchant effects and certain special perks.

functions.name: applyInfusion
functions.summary: Halves all stats from an infused item (50% stat value) while keeping perks unchanged.

functions.name: isExclusiveEnchant
functions.summary: Returns true if the enchantment has stacking='exclusive' (takes over entire slot).

functions.name: enforceEnchantSlot
functions.summary: Enforces slot constraints: deduplicates, handles exclusive enchants, and compacts filled slots.

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Formatting utilities for stat display: formats numeric stat values with +/- signs, percentage suffixes for percent-type stats, and converts camelCase stat keys to readable labels.

functions.name: formatStat
functions.summary: Formats a stat value with +/- sign and % suffix for percent-type stats.

functions.name: formatLabel
functions.summary: Converts a camelCase stat key to a readable label (e.g., 'attackSpeed' -> 'Attack Speed').

nodes.name: shrine.ts
nodes.summary: Shrine multiplier system: defines tier-based stat multipliers (3.0x at tier 1 down to 1.0x at tier 5) and applies them to weapon stats and scalings when the shrine is active.

functions.name: applyShrineToScalings
functions.summary: Multiplies all scaling values by the shrine tier multiplier.

functions.name: applyShrineToStats
functions.summary: Multiplies all stat values by the shrine tier multiplier with rounding.

nodes.name: weapon.ts
nodes.summary: Weapon calculation engine: combines blade/handle (or glove/essence for monk) stats, scalings, damage types, and perks; resolves weapon type from handle+blade combo with perk overrides; detects hybrid bonus; applies shrine multipliers and monk rank bonuses. Exports calcWeapon and calcMonkWeapon.

functions.name: calcWeapon
functions.summary: Calculates the full WeaponResult for a standard (non-monk) weapon from blade and handle names, including merged stats, scalings, damage types, weapon type resolution, and hybrid detection.

functions.name: calcMonkWeapon
functions.summary: Calculates the full WeaponResult for a monk weapon from glove and essence names, applying monk rank stat bonuses on top of shrine-scaled stats.

nodes.label: Boost.ts
nodes.description: Defines the damage boost calculation system for the Voxel Blade build calculator. Contains BoostDef/BoostContext interfaces and a comprehensive BOOST_DEFS array of 30+ damage boosts (Blood Thirsty, Frenzy, Primal, Penance, Vampire, etc.), each with either simple multiplier-per-perk values or complex custom calcFn closures. Also exports helper functions calcMinionAbsorptionPotency and calcFrenzyPct, and Penance bleed constants.
